description.en:
Was a bi-monthly yuri anthology published by Houbunsha.

The magazine started in 2009 and ran until 2012, sitting right at that point in yuri manga history where creators turned away from the pure, hierarchical, class S romances of earlier yuri toward the variety of yuri stories of today. It ran alongside Yuri Hime and the now also defunct Comic Hirari and stood in stark contrast to shoujo and josei romances of the day.

Its short run produced a number of classic yuri manga, including Higashiyama Shou's Prism, Arata Iri's Comprehensive Tovarisch, Notes from the Garden of Lillies, Kurogane Ken's Hoshikawa Ginza District, and Morinaga Milk's The Secret Recipe. Apart from the classics, the magazine included all sorts of, at the time, genre-defying yuri, including historical works, coworker, college, giant robot, and adult life stories, bi characters that weren't a toxic mess, and enough angst and drama to fuel the genre for a decade!

**Note: Several chapters from the anthology are published separately in other mangas. Please use the Related tab to see if the chapter you are looking for is in a separate manga item.**

description.en:
Minami is a high school girl who feels totally average. She's tired of blending into the background and thinks her life is boring. Daydreaming about excitement and maybe a trip to New York, she gets inspired by her favorite anime.

She tries to show off a dramatic special move to her friend Nakamura and it completely fails. Minami swears she actually did have powers yesterday, breaking a mug with the move. Nakamura isn't buying it. But then, weird things start happening at school, like classroom windows shattering for no reason. Could Minami's fantasies be real? Later, she tries her power move again.

This time, it works spectacularly, stopping rain in mid-air! Minami finally has proof: she has superpowers. She's not ordinary anymore.

Hotaru Morino is a second year high school student who has had an unrequited crush on Ren Otaka since junior high school. One day, while on a school trip with Ren and her good friend Shiori Yamamoto, their bus gets into an accident. When Hotaru wakes up, a young man who is dressed fully in black appears in front of her. He is Kuro, a grim reaper. A shocked Hotaru shoves him away but he has shocking words for her: "I'm your guide. Hotaru Morino, listen carefully. You're dead."

Hotaru learns that if she does not get over her attachment to three things within 49 days, she will end up becoming a ghost bound to a specific physical location and wouldn't be able to rest in peace. She had slept for one month after the accident and has only 19 days left. And so, Hotaru sets out to settle the three lingering regrets with the limited time she has, in the company of Kuro.

One of them is to confess her feelings to Ren, her crush of five years. However, when he is in front of her, she finds it impossible to tell him how she feels. As Hotaru settles her first lingering regret, dark clouds begin to gather over her and Kuro...

biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 浦沢直樹

Urasawa Naoki (born January 2, 1960) is a Japanese manga artist and musician. He has been drawing manga since he was four years old, and for most of his professional career has created two series simultaneously. The stories to many of these were co-written in collaboration with his former editor, Takashi Nagasaki. Urasawa has been called one of the artists that changed the history of manga and has won numerous awards, including the Shogakukan Manga Award three times, the Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize twice, and the Kodansha Manga Award once. By 2016, his various works had over 126 million copies in circulation.

His early style was inspirational and warm youth growth manga, and then turned to a deep discussion of human nature and social phenomena, covering topics such as history, psychology, criminology and science fiction. He was a 1960s and 1970s rock fan. It's influence can be strongly reflected in the *20th Century Boys*. He likes Bob Dylan very much.

description.en:
High school student Sora Ueno lives in a small mountain town, but she has never truly felt comfortable there. The only person she could open her heart to was her childhood friend, Hinako. However, on the night of the Minazuki Festival in 1984, Hinako mysteriously disappeared. Everyone in the village claimed it was a "kamikakushi"—a divine abduction—and they made little effort to search for her.

Years passed, and in 1988, Hinako suddenly returned... looking exactly the same as she did four years earlier. After her "return," Hinako faces fear and rejection from the villagers and slowly becomes isolated. Determined to protect her no matter what, Sora stays by her side. But soon, disturbing mysteries surrounding the town and Hinako's disappearance begin to surface...

Nhưng rồi vào đêm lễ hội  Minazuki, Hinako đã đột nhiên biến mất. Dân làng bảo là Kamikakushi, nên gần như chẳng buồn tìm kiếm.
Nhiều năm trôi qua. Vào năm Chiêu Hòa 63. Hinako bất ngờ trở về, vẫn vẹn nguyên dáng hình của bốn năm trước. Trở lại sau bị Kamikakushi giấu, cô bị dân làng xa lánh, khinh miệt, ngày càng cô độc. Sora quyết định bảo vệ Hinako bằng mọi giá… bất chấp điều gì đang chờ họ phía trước.
description.es-la: La estudiante de secundaria Sora Ueno vive en un pequeño pueblo de montaña, pero nunca se ha sentido realmente a gusto allí. La única persona a la que podía abrirle su corazón era su amiga de la infancia, Hinako. Sin embargo, la noche del Festival Minazuki de 1984, Hinako desapareció misteriosamente. Todos los habitantes del pueblo afirmaron que se trataba de un «kamikakushi» —un rapto divino— y no realizaron muchos esfuerzos por buscarla. Pasaron los años y, en 1988, Hinako regresó de repente... exactamente igual que cuatro años atrás. Al haber “regresado”, Hinako se enfrenta al miedo y el desprecio de los aldeanos, y poco a poco se va aislando. Decidida a protegerla sin importar lo que pase, Sora permanece a su lado, pero comienzan a salir a la luz inquietantes misterios que rodean al pueblo y la desaparición de Hinako…

description.en: Yuzuru Masaki, who made full use of his Cheat abilities in an Isekai and contributed to the defeat of the Evil God. In order to achieve a reunion with his family, he chose to return to his original world and regained his peaceful days――or so it was supposed to be. However, one day, monsters suddenly appear all over the world and begin attacking humanity. With the seal broken and his abilities regained, Yuzuru stands up once again with his former Hero Party comrades to prevent the resurrection of the Evil God.

description.en:
Kotoura Haruka is a 15-year-old girl who can read people's minds. She has been suffering from troubles caused by her mind-reading ability, and her parents got divorced as a result. She moves to a new high school but tries to keep away from her classmates. Manabe Yoshihisa, one of her classmates, accepts and appreciates her ability and she begins to interact with her friends with his help. Together, they join their school's ESP Research Club.  
  
Kotoura-san is a 4-koma manga series written by Enogizu. The series began serialization in Micro Magazine's Manga Goccha magazine from October 14, 2010. A television anime adaptation by AIC Classic began airing in January 2013.

description.en:
She was murdered. Her remains, cut cleanly in two. Her death quickly forgotten, and the killer unidentified. After all, the only fate of the weak in this world is to be trampled underfoot by the strong. However, twelve years later, her childhood friend, Inubo Mamoru, plots revenge… so that he can put a murderer overlooked by the world six feet under with his own two hands. Having found the only element missing in his years-long plan—a “partner”—Inubo sets down the long and rough road to revenge.

description.en:
"Have you heard of Summer Ghosts?"

Tomoya, Aoi, and Ryo are high school students who met through the Internet. The urban legend of the Summer Ghost is that it is a ghost of a young woman who appears when fireworks are lit.

Tomoya is unable to step out into the life he wants. Aoi is unable to find her place in the world. Ryo's bright future is suddenly closed to him. Each of them has their own reasons for meeting the Summer Ghost. On a summer night when life and death intersect, where will each of their thoughts go to?
description.ru:
Существует одна городская легенда - она о духе девушки, что появляется на заброшенном аэродроме при запуске фейерверков. Трое старшеклассников, познакомившихся в интернете, решают отправиться на поиски этого призрака, пока летние каникулы ещё не закончились.
Ночью, когда при свете искр стирается граница между миром живых и мёртвых, начнётся история, что переплетёт их судьбы
description.vi:
"Cậu đã được nghe kể về Summer Ghost chưa?"

Tomoya, Aoi và Ryo là những học sinh trung học tình cờ gặp gỡ nhau qua internet. Họ đều được nghe về một truyền thuyết đô thị nói về "Summer Ghost", linh hồn của một cô gái sẽ xuất hiện khi pháo hoa cháy sáng.

Tomoya không thể sống cuộc sống mà cậu ấy đã hình dung cho chính mình. Aoi không thể tìm thấy vị trí của mình trên thế giới. Ryo từng có một tương lai tươi sáng nhưng rồi lại đột ngột bị tước bỏ. Mỗi người đều có một lý do riêng để cần gặp Summer Ghost. Vào một đêm hè khi sự sống và cái chết giao thoa lẫn nhau, những suy nghĩ khác nhau sẽ đưa họ đến nơi đâu?
description.es-la:
¿Has oído hablar de los Fantasmas de Verano?

Tomoya, Aoi y Ryo son estudiantes de preparatoria que se conocieron por internet. La leyenda urbana del Fantasma de Verano cuenta que es el fantasma de una joven que aparece cuando se encienden fuegos artificiales.

Tomoya no puede vivir la vida que desea. Aoi no encuentra su lugar en el mundo. El brillante futuro de Ryo se le cierra repentinamente. Cada uno tiene sus propias razones para conocer al Fantasma de Verano. En una noche de verano, cuando la vida y la muerte se cruzan, ¿adónde se dirigirán sus pensamientos?

description.en:
A handsome animal photographer X a small-animal-like young man.

Haruki is a farmer in Hokkaido and one day he chanced upon Narumi, a handsome animal photographer from Tokyo who was there for a photoshoot. After Narumi mentioned that because of some mistake he now had no place to stay, Haruki then offered for him to stay at his house.

Haruki, having had a pure and clean upbringing in the countryside, has his guard up on MAX thanks to Narumi's unhesitating attempts at closing the gap between them. Unbeknownst to Haruki, Narumi actually finds Haruki's animal-like instincts unbearably cute!
